name: smarttrip
description: SmartTrip: AI travel planning and women's safety app

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.setup: npm run env:copy && npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,mobile -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix mobile run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
